source: docs/analysis/evidence/halogen-npu/xrt-stub/libxrt_coreutil-stub.c (rebuilt 2026-11-03, extracted from the reference binary via readelf -W --dyn-syms) + docs/analysis/evidence/halogen-npu/binutils-elf-info.txt DT_NEEDED
note: The XRT integration surface of the cold-cathode product lives in the sibling halogen-npu binary, not in flash_serve (flash_serve links AMD HIP instead - see npu/hip-imported-symbols.json). halogen-npu DT_NEEDEDs libxrt_coreutil.so.2 (AMD XRT). The symbol set below is the complete xrt:: import surface (20 xrt:: symbols + 2 _ITM clone-table hooks) and defines the integration surface a Rust port must target.
xrt_symbols: xrt::bo::bo(xrt::device const&, unsigned long, xrt::bo::flags, unsigned int)
xrt::bo::bo(xrt::bo const&, unsigned long, unsigned long)
lifecycle: xrt::device(index) -> xrt::elf(kernel-elf-path) -> xrt::hw_context(device, elf) -> xrt::ext::kernel(hw_context, kernel-name) -> xrt::run(kernel); weights/activations move through xrt::bo(device, size, flags, bank) with bo::map() for host access and bo::sync(HOST_TO_DEVICE / DEVICE_TO_HOST, size, offset) for transfers, plus the sub-buffer constructor xrt::bo(existing_bo, offset, size) for slicing; launch = run::set_arg_at_index(i, bo) per argument, then run::start(), then run::wait(timeout_ms) / run::state().
observed_usage_example: FUN_001afec0 (halogen-npu, npu/halogen-npu-xrt-run-launcher-FUN_001afec0.json): iterates a vector of bound argument objects, calls FUN_001af340 per argument (set_arg binding), timestamps, calls xrt::run::start(), records the launch duration and bumps global launch counters (DAT_003e7ef0, DAT_003e7e04).
